description: Erection of a part single, part double storey side and rear extension, conversion of roof space to habitable use including raising of ridge height, rear dormer and rooflights. Erection of outbuilding to rear garden (amended description)
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of its excessive scale, bulk and cumulative impact, including the extensions, roof alterations and rear outbuilding, would result in an overdevelopment of the site. The development would appear overly dominant and incongruous, failing to remain subordinate to the host dwelling and harming the character and appearance of the property and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One (2012) and Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHD 1 and DMHD 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two (2020) and the NPPF (2024).

The proposed development has failed to demonstrate that it would provide an adequate level of light and outlook for the future occupiers of the bedroom within the roof space given it is only served by one side facing rooflight. The proposal would therefore give rise to a substandard form of living accommodation to the detriment of the amenities of future occupiers contrary to Policy DMHB 16 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies and Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021).
